analysis_A.purpose: Approximate Lacuna reproduction/sanity case; not independent validation
analysis_A.input_rule: Full model-1 chain A protein from 1LXL, occupied selected heavy atoms, original coordinates/occupancy/B factors, no trimming. Derived input deferred until approval.
analysis_A.interpretation: Explicit NMA/no-sequence approximation. Do not attribute these choices to the published showcase.

lacuna_output_policy: Later tested API wrapper emits all clusters in native rank order and native input coordinate frame, no score thresholds, no assembly expansion, no pocket/docking files. No wrapper executes now.

primary.centroid: reference-residue CA mean in evaluated input frame

failure_policy: Reject missing artifacts, automatic detector/backend/ranker/sequence fallback, NMA degeneracy fallback, malformed output, invalid centers/ranks, or hash mismatch. Preserve FAILED and actual error; never substitute outputs.
execution_prerequisites: tested wrappers enforcing configuration, native-frame output and no fallback
separately provenance Analysis A full-chain input
